app_info.subtitle: Play interactive fiction
app_info.description: LoreSight lets people open a CRT-based interactive-fiction player, browse a story library, load supported Z-machine files, play a bundled sample, submit commands, change the display theme, and request optional narration of visible story text.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new private LoreSight session and returns its initial player-safe state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only a private LoreSight session and does not publish or contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts a session without deleting, overwriting, or revoking existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the available LoreSight story titles, authors, formats, and sources without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a closed LoreSight catalog and does not write to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Requests that the mounted widget show the story library without changing story or catalog data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the private widget presentation and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a user-directed local file-selection workflow for a supported Z-machine file; the server does not read the filesystem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Loads only a file the user explicitly selects into the private widget and does not upload or publish it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or modify the selected local file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts the bundled sample story in a private LoreSight player session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the local player experience and does not affect public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke any user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies the selected CRT theme to the user's private widget and saves the presentation preference locally.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private LoreSight presentation state and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter story content or delete existing preferences.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends only the feedback the user explicitly submits, along with bounded diagnostic metadata when selected.
justifications.open_world_justification: Records feedback for LoreSight support and does not publish content or contact third parties on the user's behalf.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a feedback record without deleting, overwriting, or revoking user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current player-safe story recap without advancing or changing the session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private LoreSight session state and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current player-safe scene, progress, released clues, and available choices without changing the session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private LoreSight session state and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Commits one validated command to the private LoreSight session and advances its authoritative state version.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only a closed LoreSight session and does not post, send, or publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends a retry-safe event and rejects stale or duplicate mutations rather than deleting or rewriting history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current safe session snapshot and renders the interactive interface without changing story state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Renders private LoreSight information and does not modify public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates temporary audio from already visible story text without changing canonical story state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns narration privately to the current widget and does not publish it or contact user-selected third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Open LoreSight and browse available stories.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open LoreSight, show me the library, and tell me which formats are available.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts the player and presents the library action or library results without changing a story session.

test_cases.description: Retrieve and inspect the story catalog.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the stories available in LoreSight.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns story titles, authors, supported formats, and source labels.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open the file picker so I can play my .z5 game.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the LoreSight local file-selection flow and accepts only supported Z-machine formats.

test_cases.description: Advance an active story with a guarded command.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my active LoreSight story, examine the door.
test_cases.expected_output: Commits the command at the current state version and returns the next player-safe story state.

test_cases.description: Request optional narration of visible story text.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read the current visible LoreSight scene aloud.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns temporary narration for only the visible scene and identifies it as AI-generated voice.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke LoreSight for unrelated information requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather in Boston tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside interactive-fiction workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use LoreSight as a general audiobook service.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Narrate this entire novel as an audiobook.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because narration is limited to visible LoreSight story text.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim unsupported publishing or creator administration capabilities.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish my draft story to a public game directory.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that the player tools do not publish stories or administer a public directory.
